image.body: One QR code on the counter. House guidance, local favourites and a wall of guest memories.

posts.alt: DigiStayBook logo above the words 'A guestbook your rental never had', with three points: no app for guests, no guest accounts, made for short-term rental hosts.

Hello from DigiStayBook 👋

We're building a digital guestbook for short-term rental hosts.

One QR code sits on the counter. Guests scan it with their phone camera to find your house guidance and your local favourites, and to leave a memory for the next people who stay.

No app to download. No account to create.

We're in the final stretch before launch. Follow the Page to see how it works over the next week, and to hear first when we open the doors.

posts.goal: Name the problem hosts feel every changeover: the same questions, again and again.

headline: What's the Wi-Fi?
Which bin goes out?
image.body: Answer once. Guests find it in one tap.

posts.alt: A phone showing the DigiStayBook demo guest page with 'Your stay essentials' buttons for Wi-Fi, Bins, Checkout and Heating.
posts.caption:
What's the Wi-Fi password?
Which bin goes out, and when?
What time is checkout?
How does the heating work?

If you host, you've answered these more times than you can count, usually by message and usually late at night.

With DigiStayBook you write the answers once. Guests scan the QR code in the house and find them in a single tap: Wi-Fi, bins, checkout, heating, whatever your place needs.

The screenshot is from our demo property, Seabreeze Cottage.

Hosts: which question do you get asked most? Tell us below 👇

posts.goal: Explain the product in three simple steps.

headline: Three steps.
No app.
steps: Put the QR display on the counter
Guests scan it with their camera
They read your guidance and leave a memory

posts.alt: A printed DigiStayBook QR display for the demo property Seabreeze Cottage, next to three steps: put the QR display on the counter, guests scan it with their camera, they read your guidance and leave a memory.
posts.caption:
How DigiStayBook works, in three steps:

1️⃣ You set up your property's page once: welcome note, house guidance, local tips.
2️⃣ You print the QR display and pop it on the kitchen counter.
3️⃣ Guests scan it with their phone camera. They read everything they need, then leave a message or photo on your guest wall before they go.

No app download and no sign-up for your guests. It opens straight in the browser.

Launching soon. Follow along so you don't miss it.

#ShortTermRental #HolidayRental #AirbnbHost #QRCode #DigiStayBook

posts.goal: Show the emotional side: the memories guests leave behind.

headline: The memories
guests leave behind.
image.body: Every stay adds to your property's wall.

posts.alt: A phone showing the DigiStayBook demo guest wall with a coastal photo and a guest message about walking to the lighthouse every morning.
posts.caption:
Remember the paper guestbook on the hall table? 📖

The best ones were full of little stories: the walk everyone loved, the café worth the detour, the family who came back every summer.

DigiStayBook brings that back for the way people travel now. Guests leave a message and a photo from their phone, and it joins your property's guest wall for the next guests to read.

This is a sneak peek from our demo property. The cottage and the messages are made up for the demo, but the wall is the real thing.

#GuestBook #ShortTermRental #HolidayRental #AirbnbHost #DigiStayBook

posts.goal: Position the host as the local expert; the tips are part of the stay.

headline: The tips only
a host would know.
image.body: Share your favourite places, right where guests look.

posts.alt: A phone showing a tip from the demo hosts on the DigiStayBook guest page: 'Our favourite: the bakery behind the lighthouse. Go before 9am or the pasties are gone.'
posts.caption:
The best part of staying somewhere new? The tips you'd never find on your own. 🥐

The bakery behind the lighthouse. The beach that's quiet at sunset. The pub with the open fire.

You already know these places. DigiStayBook gives you somewhere to share them, right where your guests look first. Pin your favourites to the top of your property's page and they're there for every stay.

The tip in the picture comes from our demo cottage.

posts.theme: Simple for guests, in your control
posts.goal: Answer the first objections: guests won't download apps, and hosts worry about what gets posted.

headline: Easy for guests.
Yours to control.
image.body: Guests scan and go. You decide what stays on your wall.
ticks: Turn on approval for new memories

posts.alt: Text card: 'Easy for guests. Yours to control.' with four points: opens in the phone's browser, no guest sign-up, turn on approval for new memories, hide or remove any post.
posts.caption:
Two questions hosts often ask about digital guestbooks:

"My guests won't download an app."
They don't have to. DigiStayBook opens in the phone's browser straight from the QR code. No app, no account, no password.

"What if someone posts something I don't want there?"
You're in control. Every new memory goes through automatic safety checks, you can turn on approval so nothing appears until you say so, and you can hide or remove any post from your dashboard.

What else would you want to know before using a digital guestbook? Ask away below.

#ShortTermRental #HolidayRental #AirbnbHost #HostLife #DigiStayBook
